meta.title: Hanun Ameqqran, aɛdaw n At Barka (lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa)
meta.desc: Hanun Ameqqran, anezwi n tejmaɛt tanaẓurt n Qarṭaǧ deg lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa : tinyafin tifrikiyin, tirẓa deg umenɣi n yimirsinariyen, tamsimɛet akked Hamilkar Barka d uqabel n umenɣi n Hanibal akken i d-yeqqar Tite-Live.
hero.chip: Amezruy n tudert · Lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa
hero.dates: Yella ɣer 247 – armi d tagara n lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa
hero.title: Hanun Ameqqran
hero.epithet: Argaz n Afrika mgal At Barka
hero.lede: Amenyaf n lqaɛa n Libya deffir, anezwi ur yelhi ara deg umenɣi n yimirsinariyen, amsimɛi n Hamilkar imbeɛd aɛdaw ibeggnen n Hanibal : Hanun, i Yimezwura, d acaraf n Qarṭaǧ n yimawlan ibariyen, win yebɣan talwit akked Ṛuma.
hero.caption: Qarṭaǧ, tiɣilt n Byrsa
keys.0.t: ṭṭef n Hécatompyle, deg lqaɛa n Libya deffir (Diodore)
keys.1.t: iḥebbasen ttwaṭṭfen di Hécatompyle, tamdint tettwaselkem (Diodore, XXIV, 10)
keys.2.t: ilfilen deg lɛesker-is zdat Utique, deg 240 (Polybe, I, 74)
keys.3.t: imeqqranen n Senṭ ttwaznen iwakken ad t-id-sseṛḥben akked Hamilkar (Polybe, I, 87)
intro.title: Anwa i gella d Hanun ?
intro.paras.0: Ur nessin ara twacult-is, azemz n talalit-is neɣ win n lmut-is. Hanun d-iḍhir deg yiɣbula ɣer 247, d anezwi n Iqarṭaǧiyen di Afrika, yekkes-d mbeɛd umenɣi apuni wis sin. Isem-is wis sin « Ameqqran » ițwaseqdac i t-id-ifaṛqen seg wid yesɛan isem-nni ; tira ssemmant-as abeɛda kan Hanun.
intro.paras.1: I Polybe am Tite-Live, d udem agejdan n tejmaɛt : tin n yimawlan ibariyen n tmurt tafrikit, ẓedɣen ɣef lekdeb n tmura, ɛadawen tilkiwin n At Barka ibeɛdan. Usmel-agi yesbegen tamsimɛet-agi deg usebter n tnezmariyin.
homonyms.title: Aṭas n Hanun
homonyms.items.0.v: Ameskar yettwaḥesben n Periplus ɣef rrif n Afrika di Lebḥer Aṭlasi (lqern wis 5 ?).
homonyms.items.1.v: Amezdaɣ yesɛan tazmert akteṛ deg lweqt-is, Justin (XXI, 4) ibegen-it-id yettɛawad ad yeddem tanezmert ; nețța daɣen tikwal yettusemma « Ameqqran ».
homonyms.items.2.v: Yettwazen mgal yimirsinariyen ikkren deg tegzirt, ittwasellab sɣur lɛesker-is s yiman-is (Polybe, I, 79).
homonyms.items.3.v: Iwakken d arbib n Hanibal, anezwi n yineggafen deg tazegrart n Rhône deg 218.
life.title: Ayen i as-qqaren yiɣbula
life.rows.0.title: Afrika d tamezwarut
life.rows.0.text: Anezwi di Afrika lawan n umenɣi deg Sicile, yeṭṭef Hécatompyle, tamdint tilibikit yettwaḥesben, s telqey, d Theveste (Tébessa) — ayen yezmer maca ur mṣadan ara akk fell-as (Diodore, XXIV, 10 ; Polybe, I, 73).
life.rows.1.title: Zdat yimirsinariyen
life.rows.1.text: Yettwaklef ad imeslay i yimirsinariyen idduklen di Sicca, yeqqar-asen Lḥekma txuṣṣ idrimen : iɛeskriyen-agi, ur ten-yenzewi ara di Sicile, ḥadren fell-as. Tkerrust tekker (Polybe, I, 66–67).
life.rows.2.title: Utique
life.rows.2.text: S lmakinat n umenɣi akked azal n meyya n ilfilen, isserɣel ikerrasen seg wemkan-nsen zdat Utique, imbeɛd yețwaṭṭef mi d-uɣalen (Polybe, I, 74).
life.rows.3.title: Hamilkar d umgired
life.rows.3.text: Hamilkar yettwasemma d anezwi. Amgired ger sin inezwayen meqqer armi lɛesker ttwasuturen ad fernen : ṭṭfen Hamilkar, Hanun ittwakkes (Polybe, I, 82).
life.rows.4.title: Aseṛḥeb s telɣa
life.rows.4.text: Mbeɛd tirẓa zdat Tunes, tlatin n imeqqranen n Senṭ sserfden aseṛḥeb ; Hanun d Hamilkar nyafen Mathos akked snat, fukken umenɣi (Polybe, I, 87–88).
life.rows.5.title: Mgal « tgelda » n At Barka
life.rows.5.text: Mi gessuter Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ ad d-yas Hanibal ameẓyan ɣer Hispanya, Hanun yegra fell-as deg Senṭ (Tite-Live, XXI, 3).
life.rows.6.title: Ad yettwafk Hanibal ?
life.rows.6.text: Mbeɛd ṭṭef n Sagonte, yessuter ad yettwafk Hanibal i Ṛuma iwakken ad iḥader umenɣi. Ur t-ḍfiṛen ara (Tite-Live, XXI, 10).
life.rows.7.title: Mbeɛd Kan
life.rows.7.text: Lawan i d-yessawel Magun Barka tanyafit, yeqqar-as ad meslayen ɣef talwit lawan yellan deg tezmert (Tite-Live, XXIII, 12–13).
life.rows.8.title: Agḍiḍ n Hanibal
life.rows.8.text: Yuɣal-d seg Italya, Hanibal yegḍeḍ ccah n Senṭ akked Hanun belli d nutni i d-yesbabben uɣelli-ines (Tite-Live, XXX, 20).
policy.title: Snat tsertiyin i Qarṭaǧ
policy.aside: Deg lqern wis 3, snat n temuɣliwin mgalent deg Senṭ ; iɣbula sbegnent-tent-id deg sin yirgazen.
policy.items.0.title: Tamurt n Afrika
policy.items.0.text: Simɣur d usexdem n tmurt n Libya, aɣbalu n idrimen n yimawlan ibariyen ; aḥadar n umenɣi amaynut akked Ṛuma. Polybe yettales-d taẕayt n tsertit-agi : deg umenɣi apuni amezwaru, ssutren i ifellaḥen ilibikiyen azgen n tmegra-nsen (I, 72) — d ayen i d-ifehhmen amlalay-nsen akked yimirsinariyen.
policy.items.1.title: Lebḥer akked Hispanya
policy.items.1.text: Lexlaṣ n uxesser n Sicile s tgelda deg Hispanya, yesɛan nnuqra akked yirgazen, akked uswejed n tririt. Polybe (III, 8), yettales-d ṛṛay n Fabius Pictor, isbeggen-d At Barka ṭṭfen ɣef lmaḥaba n ugdud ; M. Sznycer yekkes idea n tgelda am ta n Igrikiyen.
merc.title: Anezwi ur yelhi ara
merc.intro: Anezwi amezwaru n umenɣi-agi, Hanun d amesnerni ɛziz, akken i t-id-iqbel Polybe, maca d anezwi ur nelhi ara deg umenɣi : yessen ad yesdukkel lɛesker, war ma yezmer ad yeddem tagniţ. Tirẓa-ines teldi abrid i Hamilkar.
merc.steps.0.d: Yusa-d ad yessuter i yiɛeskriyen ad ǧǧen amur n lexlaṣ-nsen. Amgired yuɣal d tkerrust ldin.
merc.steps.1.d: Yenyaf deg umenɣi amezwaru s ilfilen, yuɣal ɣer tmdint war ma yḍfaṛ ; ikerrasen uɣalen-d ṭṭfen-as ayla-ines.
merc.steps.2.d: Tamsimɛet-is akked Hamilkar tḥebbes taɛessast : lɛesker yefren Hamilkar (Polybe, I, 82).
merc.steps.3.d: Yettwaṛeḥben sɣur tejmaɛt n Senṭ, yettnaɣ akked Hamilkar lɛesker aneggaru n Mathos, i gettwanyafen i gettwaṭṭfen.
quote.kicker: Hanun deg Senṭ, deg 221, akken i d-yeqqar Tite-Live
quote.tr: Tuttra n Hasdrubal tbanet-d d tin yelhan, maca ur fellaɣ ara ad as-fket ayen i gessuter. […] Uggadeɣ ass ad texleɛ tirgit-agi tamecṭuḥt times tameqqrant.
speeches.title: Mgal umenɣi n Hanibal
speeches.aside: Krad n taqsisin i d-yettwales Tite-Live : qqaren drus ayen i d-yenna Hanun ugar wayen i tebɣa Ṛuma ad tesel.
speeches.items.0.title: Ḥader aqcic di Qarṭaǧ
speeches.items.0.text: Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ yessuter Hanibal ameẓyan. Hanun yebɣa ad immɣur ddaw iseḥḥaren n temdint, mačči deg wemkan n umenɣi anda ara isselmed ad yenzewi am bab.
speeches.items.1.title: Afk n Hanibal
speeches.items.1.text: Mbeɛd Sagonte, yettales-d talwit yettwagall, iqeddeṛ amenɣi n uxessar, yeqqar-as ad yettwafk Hanibal i ibaɛɛaten iṛumaniyen. Senṭ yefren amenɣi.
speeches.items.2.title: Talwit mbeɛd Kan
speeches.items.2.text: Zdat iẓegwan n ddheb i d-yewwi Magun, yesteqsi anwa agdud alatini i yexdeɛen : ulayɣer. Ṛuma ur teknu ara ; d lawan n umeslay.
critic.title: D amusnaw, s tidet ?
critic.paras.0: Tite-Live d aɛdaw n Hanibal : yeg Hanun d taɣect n lɛeqel, tin i gessnen kullec send lawan. Taqsisin-agi d asnulfu n tsekla, yettwaran sin iqrunen mbeɛd, mačči d tira n tidet.
critic.paras.1: Polybe, iqeṛb ugar ɣer tidet, d aqsiḥ ɣef unezwi Hanun. Akked umgired yefrqen ger « lḥizb n Hanun » d « lḥizb n At Barka » yessishil, ammas, urar n tsertit i gebnan s tgallelt ibeddlen.
after.title: Talwit d talast
after.paras.0: Mi gṣuffeɣ Italya deg 203, Hanibal yesmenyif Hanun gar wid i t-yexsren seg tallalt. Mbeɛd Zama (202), tajmaɛt yebɣan talwit tenyaf, tagallelt n 201 tettwaqbel.
after.paras.1: Hanun, imir-nni d amɣar, yekkes-d seg yiɣbula. Hanun-nniḏen d-ḍheren deg taqsisin n iseggasen 204–201 akked 150–149 : ulac ayen i d-ibeggnen d yiwen n urgaz i gellan.
sourcesNote.title: Seg wanda i d-yekka wayen i nessen
sourcesNote.items.0.text: Amenɣi n yimirsinariyen : Sicca, Utique, tamsimɛet akked Hamilkar, aseṛḥeb (I, 66–88).
sourcesNote.items.1.text: Ṭṭef n Hécatompyle d uselkem n temdint, yettwaḥerzen deg tucḍiwin.
sourcesNote.items.2.text: Taqsisin mgal umenɣi (XXI, 3 d 10 ; XXIII, 12–13) akked ugḍiḍ n Hanibal (XXX, 20).
sourcesNote.items.3.text: Taqsisin-is n tagara n umenɣi apuni wis sin akked wis krad bedren aṭas n Hanun : asleḥ-nsen akked uɛdaw n Hamilkar mazal-it ur yefra ara.
